sources.title: The Size Distribution of Void Filaments in a LCDM Cosmology
sources.snippet: The size distribution of mini-filaments in voids has been derived from the Millennium Run halo catalogs at redshifts z=0,0.5,1 and 2. It is assumed that the primordial tidal field originated the presence of filamentary substructures in voids and that the void filaments have evolved only little, keeping the initial memory of the primordial tidal field.
